rule: FinOps IQ platform playbook (WS-S3; PLAN F8; IMPROVEMENT_PLAN 5.1). Controls are FIN.<CAPABILITY> for capability gap findings and FIN.<LEVER> for levers (e.g. FIN.ALLOCATION, FIN.LEV-01). The approach comes first, then options per platform, named as the provider names them on the review date, with open-source or third-party alternatives where credible; options are validated per engagement against current availability, pricing and licensing. Every control in technicalControls has an entry, or an explicit noPlatformAction entry saying why, for every platform. Where no provider-specific option is catalogued (IBM Cloud, Alibaba Cloud or an unidentified provider for some levers), the entry is a Low-confidence practice action whose options are found in discovery. Other controls (anomaly management, Kubernetes efficiency, SaaS and licensing) have entries on selected platforms only. Each entry cites claims in the claims register and is reviewed by its nextReview date, which is never later than the review date of the claims it cites.
